denominator: Workflow comparison. Counts are not normalized into a synthetic per-drug cohort.
stages:
Large libraries predate generative AI.
The investment mechanism is better selection and learning.

Small molecules can need fewer syntheses per program.
Protein libraries and individual profiling are different units.

Analyst workload sensitivities, not predicted fully profiled
candidate counts. Include an efficiency/no-growth case.

Clinical biology, patients, capital and time remain
constraints; discovery gains do not establish clinical gains.

BIO 2011–2020 and Wong 2000–2015 are different
cohorts and methods, not an AI comparison.
